summary_en: This study tests FT825 (also known as ONO-8250), an off-the-shelf HER2 CAR T-cell therapy, with or without monoclonal antibody therapy, in people with advanced solid tumors. FT825 is given by intravenous infusion after chemotherapy in Cycle 1, and each cycle is about 61 days; a second cycle may be considered based on safety and clinical benefit. The study measures safety, tolerability, and antitumor activity, and it is a Phase 1 study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa FT825 (también conocido como ONO-8250), una terapia de células T CAR dirigida a HER2 de tipo disponible para uso inmediato, con o sin anticuerpos monoclonales, en personas con tumores sólidos avanzados. FT825 se administra por infusión intravenosa después de la quimioterapia en el Ciclo 1, y cada ciclo dura aproximadamente 61 días; se podría considerar un segundo ciclo según la seguridad y el beneficio clínico. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad y la actividad antitumoral, y es un estudio de Fase 1.
who_for: Histopathological or cytologic confirmation of locally advanced or metastatic cancer that meets protocol criteria.
Disease not amenable to curative therapy.
Measurable disease by RECIST 1.1 within 28 days before first study treatment.
Anticipated life expectancy of at least 3 months.
not_for: Women who are pregnant or breastfeeding.
Known active central nervous system involvement by cancer.
Prior CAR T-cell therapy, other cellular therapy, or a Fate iPSC product.
Current or past interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis requiring steroids, or suspected and not ruled out by imaging.
Active or past autoimmune disease or immune deficiency.
